spans.s: The third letter of the cerebral class of consonants, having the sound of D, pronounced far back in the head: it is often confounded in pronounciation with a hard R, or L, sounded as in the Northumbrian bur; it is written in the Roman character D.

Submarine fire.
5 A kind of drum or tabor.
f. (डा)
1 A kind of female imp or goblin.
2 A basket, &c. carried by a sling: see डलक.
E.
डप to collect, affix ड.
